title: Martian Crustal Magnetic Field Heterogeneity and Implications for Biological Systems at Candidate Landing Sites
description: Analysis pipeline, publication-quality figures, and interactive WebGL visualization for Martian crustal magnetic field data derived from NASA Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) and MAVEN orbital magnetometer measurements. Includes a systematic review of hypomagnetic field effects on terrestrial biology and a risk assessment framework for biological systems at current, historical, and future human Mars landing sites.
notes: Accompanying data pipeline, manuscript LaTeX source, and figures formatted for Nature Publishing Group submission. All raw magnetometer data sourced from NASA Planetary Data System (PDS).
